svg.title: Platform fit depends on the execution environment and deployment mode, not just the product name.
svg.desc: Eight requirements are compared across Cloud Run service, Cloud Run job, Fargate, Managed Agents, Deep Agents Deploy, and Kubernetes Job. A tilde marks capabilities that require a caveat. Sandbox choice includes custom integration on owned runtimes and configured selection on managed harnesses; it does not mean copying or forking running state. Managed Agents has hosted orchestration with optional customer-operated execution; Claude Platform on AWS is separate from Bedrock.

text.font-family: Space Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: No single green cell decides the architecture — the caveated cells usually do.
